concept: A manifesto for a counterintuitive tool: a coding agent that edits video from the transcript and never watches a frame. The bold claim is earned by three mechanism beats (a real prompt, the self-correcting loop, the ask-first discipline) before the inverted reveal spends the contrast budget, then a star receipt and a wordmark close that loops back to the open.
money_shot_note: Scene 6, the inverted flash 'never watches', is the peak: it is the one polarity flip and the single most quotable frame, positioned at 71 percent so everything builds to it.
transition_strategy: Fade-through cuts, outgoing settles before incoming starts, a chromatic tick on each cut; the flash cut lands hardest with a whoosh into an impact.
music_direction: Electronic bed, propulsive and precise (browser-use premium-tech), building under the loop and peaking at the flash; cuts snapped to onsets by beat_align.
